summary: Submitted unchanged; validated as no_change with no effects, so nothing is created or duplicated. Before stopping I re-checked the source anchors the two accounts rely on and they hold exactly: snapshot.go:155-190 contains the committed configuration and index that takeSnapshot passes to SnapshotStore.Create, api.go:653-684 contains the setLastApplied, setCommittedConfiguration and setLatestConfiguration calls that install a restored snapshot's configuration, and raft.go:508-528 contains the inflight ErrLeadershipLost response that explains the surviving leader's error text in the availability witness. Both investigations are complete, gaps-free and internally consistent: configuration recovery (98ee8dfd5fac4b84915f91ed4b094bcf-question-0, violated, defect asserted) on eight receipts covering the single-voter recovery cases with flag-off controls, the three-voter commit-rule witness reproduced four times, the durable-snapshot corruption surviving a flag-off restart, the authority pair with its premise-failure repeat and premise-enforcing revision, and the two-voter vote boundary in two executions; replay completion (29e4214f5ee146b393957fa23a33a73d-question-0, violated, defect asserted) on eleven receipts covering the block pair, the measured bound pair, the availability consequence at two batch sizes, the exact 128-delivered-batch boundary at two batch sizes, and default-configuration reachability reproduced twice. Three knowledge corrections are recorded with changed premises, affected uses and answered gaps; 54 claims across 14 receipts were verified against observations with no discrepancy. Remaining limits are structural and stated in each account; with about seven minutes left no citable probe can be completed, so the run expires with this state preserved.
